_comment: Pinned downloads for the offline Windows package. Every file is checked against its SHA-256 before use. Update a version only together with its checksum from the publisher.

python.name: Python (CPython, NuGet package 'python')
python.checksum_source: nuget.org catalog packageHash (SHA-512) for python 3.13.17, verified before pinning

jre.name: Eclipse Temurin JRE (Windows x64)
jre.checksum_source: api.adoptium.net package checksum, re-verified on download

jmeter.name: Apache JMeter
jmeter.checksum_source: apache-jmeter-5.6.3.tgz.sha512 from archive.apache.org (SHA-512 verified, SHA-256 pinned here)

speech_model.name: Vosk speech model (small English, offline voice commands)
speech_model.publisher: Alpha Cephei (vosk-model-small-en-us-0.15), mirrored by Rhasspy on Hugging Face
speech_model.checksum_source: Git LFS SHA-256 of en/vosk-model-small-en-us-0.15.zip in huggingface.co/rhasspy/vosk-models

llama_server.name: llama.cpp llama-server (Windows x64, CPU)
llama_server.checksum_source: GitHub release asset digest, re-verified on download

llm_model.name: Qwen2.5-1.5B-Instruct GGUF (Q4_K_M), the On-Premise AI model
llm_model.checksum_source: SHA-256 (Git LFS object id) Hugging Face publishes for each file of the revision

fw_model.name: Faster-Whisper small.en (CTranslate2), speech recognition model
fw_model.publisher: SYSTRAN on Hugging Face (OpenAI Whisper small.en converted)
fw_model.checksum_source: SHA-256 (Git LFS) or Git blob SHA-1 Hugging Face publishes for each file of the revision

_comment_models: Models come from Hugging Face. With an empty revision the build takes the repository's current revision, checks every file against the checksum Hugging Face publishes for it, and prints the revision and SHA-256 to pin here (revision, sha256 {file: hash}); once pinned, a file that differs is refused.
